## Necessary caller adaptations and test method

Constructor injection requires the existing signing-secret migration to resolve its encryptor from the container. Six existing test construction sites also provide/resolve the new dependency. These small caller adaptations are required by the requested DI change, although the initial Files list omitted them. `UPGRADE.md` documents the constructor change required by the plan-wide public API rule.

`NodeStoreRepository` is final. Instead of bypassing final or changing its public contract, V17 throws from the synchronous Eloquent `created` event inside `NodeStoreRepository::create()`, immediately after the actual insertion. The assertions prove connection identity and open transaction level before the injected exception; row count proves rollback. `NodeCreated` itself dispatches after commit and is unsuitable for rollback injection.

Grok identified the remaining model connection gap as a live transaction regression, including when both connection names target the same database. The four existing UploadSession, UploadPart, NodeComment and NodeDocumentVersion models now use the existing ResolvesVaulterConnection trait. New regression datasets prove connection identity and actual rollback for each model; removal of those traits reproduces the defect. The obsolete database-guide warning was removed and the upgrade/changelog entries updated. These additional model files are necessary to satisfy the item's same-connection invariant. Model validation is in model-validation.json; the original broad gates are reused for unchanged files.
